description: The producer's operator has the sign of one bond coupling flipped (J -> -J on bond (0,1); for the TFIM the field on site 0 is doubled); the eigenpairs are correct for the producer's operator but the declared model is the intended one.
note: the producer's operator is not the declared model; S2-S4 may be certified for the producer's operator (the certificate must say which operator the radii refer to)
